candidates.title: 🎉DKC 26/27 TASTER SESSIONS🎉

caption.text:
🎉DKC 26/27 TASTER SESSIONS🎉

Thank you so much for expressing interest in the Durham Kendo Club! It was lovely talking to all of you at the Fresher’s Fair. 

We are now able to confirm the following dates for the 3 taster sessions: 

Monday 5th October, 19:30-21:30 (The Ballroom - E01)
Wednesday 7th October, 19:30-21:30 (Vane Tempest - D16)
Monday 12th October, 19:30-21:30 (The Ballroom - E01)

These rooms are located in Dunelm House, the Students’ Union building, which may be found in the postcode DH1 3AN. 

You are welcome to join all three of our taster sessions, but there is limited space in our venues. 

Therefore, we ask that you fill out this form: https://forms.gle/RmLDkJQhzELfKoTL9 and confirm at most two dates that you are sure you will be able to attend. The form will close on Sunday, 4th October, 23:59, so please sign up before then.

**Please note that, as the Wednesday taster session will be at a smaller venue, we may have to prioritise those that cannot attend ANY Monday taster sessions. A confirmation email will be sent to confirm your RSVP for the Wednesday session. 

If you do not receive the email, please make it your priority to join us for our Monday sessions. 

Feel free to contact us on our Instagram @durhamkendo or kendo.society@durham.ac.uk for any enquiries.

We look forward to seeing you!
